tools.name: check_coverage_gap
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how much life insurance they need, whether the coverage they have is enough, or which kind of life insurance fits their family. This is a detailed financial calculation, not an estimate: Clearline runs the same deterministic engines as the Check and the calculator on clear

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_coverage_gap" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
